subject: Billing handover: invoice path & tax delegation for CloudScale order form
messages:
From: Maya Shah <maya@cloudscale.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: ap@cloudscale.com
Date: 2028-09-12T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Next steps for order form / PO + VAT questions

Hi Logan,

Thanks — CloudScale is ready to move forward but we need to lock the invoice routing and VAT handling before countersign. Two quick asks from our procurement team:

1) AP wants invoices routed to ap@cloudscale.com with the PO number in the subject line. See attached PDF with the PO request format.
2) We are EU-based and will be operating under reverse-charge for services; we need Redwood's guidance on whether you will issue invoices net of VAT and accept our VAT number, or if you require billing from a Redwood EU entity.

Also: We have a preference for splitting invoices to match the commit tranches (quarterly billing by tranche) — can Redwood issue multiple invoices per quarter tied to minimum commit tranches?

Please advise who on your side will own routing + tax evidence so our AP can finalize the PO.

Thanks,
Maya Shah
Head of Procurement | CloudScale Inc
attachment: CloudScale_PO_request.pdf (pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya@cloudscale.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-12T10:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for order form / PO + VAT questions

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask and the PO stub. Looping in Kim (revenue ops) and Karthik (legal) to confirm the practical flow and any redlines we need on the Order Form. Quick points from sales:

- We can accept a PO in advance; please ensure the PO number is included on the invoice subject and PDF.
- We need confirmation on the billing entity (US vs EU). Kim: can you confirm whether finance can bill CloudScale from our EU entity if that avoids VAT exposure?
- Karthik: any Order Form clause we should add to capture the split-invoice/tranche approach and VAT responsibility?

I attached a draft invoice template so Kim can call out missing fields that AP needs. Next steps: Kim to confirm entity & standard net terms; Karthik to propose redlines to the Order Form.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
attachment: draft_invoice_template.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Maya Shah <maya@cloudscale.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-12T11:00:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for order form / PO + VAT questions

Hi all —Finance notes below and suggested path:

1) Invoice routing: we will send invoices to ap@cloudscale.com (please confirm that AP will include the PO on the invoice PDF and the email subject). We prefer a single consolidated invoice per calendar month for all charges, but we can support tranche-based invoices where each invoice references the specific commit tranche.

2) Billing entity & VAT: for CloudScale (EU) we recommend billing from our EU entity to avoid EU VAT complexity. If we must bill from our US entity, then we will issue invoices without VAT and you should confirm your VAT number for reverse-charge. Please attach your VAT registration now so we can validate.

3) Net terms & exceptions: Our standard terms are Net 30 from invoice date. We can consider Net 45 for this account pending approval from Revenue Ops if CloudScale can commit to the minimum annual commit in the Order Form.

4) Withholding: if CloudScale will withhold local taxes, we require a completed tax certificate for their finance file.

Next steps for us: I will map the final invoice entity and update the billing_flow_diagram (attached) and confirm whether we need an EU entity invoice. If CloudScale can provide VAT number, please send it now.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
attachment: billing_flow_diagram.png (png)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Shah <maya@cloudscale.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-12T13:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for order form / PO + VAT questions

Thanks — from a legal perspective we should:

- Add a short Invoice Routing clause to the Order Form that notes: "Customer will provide a PO prior to the first invoice; invoices must reference the PO and be sent to the AP email on file. Redwood will not be responsible for payment delays caused by missing or incorrect PO references."
- Add a VAT/Tax allocation clause: "Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Customer is responsible for all taxes, duties and withholdings related to payments. If Customer is located in a jurisdiction that requires withholding taxes, Customer will provide documentation evidencing the withholding and / or tax relief within 30 days of the request."
- For tranche-based invoicing: add a line in the Order Form appendix that defines "Invoice Tranches" (match the minimum commit schedule) and allows Redwood to issue separate invoices for each tranche.

I've uploaded a tracked-redline to the shared doc (link below) and attached the redline doc. If everyone agrees on the language, I can fold it into the Order Form and send for signature via DocuSign.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachment: orderform_redlines.docx (docx)
link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFGHIjK-orderform-redlines

From: Maya Shah <maya@cloudscale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudScale AP <ap@cloudscale.com>, Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@cloudscale.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T14:10:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for order form / PO + VAT questions

Thanks Karthik — that language looks sensible. For your records I attached our VAT certificate and our AP contact confirms the PO format. A few clarifications from CloudScale:

- VAT number: GB999888777 (certificate attached). We will self-assess (reverse-charge) if the invoice indicates services provided to an EU entity.
- PO usage: AP will reject invoices that do not have the PO number in the subject line and the PO PDF attached.
- Tranche invoicing: AP prefers separate invoices per tranche (that maps to our internal budget lines). If Redwood issues tranche invoices we will pay each within the agreed net terms.

Please confirm whether Redwood can: 1) bill from Redwood EU entity (preferred), or 2) if billing from Redwood US entity, issue invoices net of VAT and rely on our reverse-charge documentation.

Thanks —
Maya Shah
Head of Procurement | CloudScale Inc
attachment: CloudScale_VAT_certificate.pdf (pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Maya Shah <maya@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-12T15:42:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for order form / PO + VAT questions

Great — thanks for the VAT cert and AP confirmation, Maya. Quick summary and next steps so we can close: 

1) Finance will confirm by EOD tomorrow whether we will invoice from our EU entity (preferred) or from the US entity with reverse-charge handling.
2) If we invoice from EU entity we will include VAT where applicable. If US entity, we will issue invoices without VAT and rely on CloudScale's reverse-charge evidence; AP must include the PO number on each invoice.
3) Legal to fold the redlined wording into the Order Form (Karthik will update the doc and send via DocuSign).
4) We can support tranche-based invoicing; finance will map the tranche IDs to invoice line references so AP can reconcile.

Action owners: Kim to confirm billing entity and net terms exception path; Karthik to publish the final Order Form redline into DocuSign; CloudScale/AP to include PO on every invoice PDF and in email subject.

I'll follow up with an internal wrap-up once Kim confirms the billing entity.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
